packageRules.description: Security patches get immediate PRs, auto-merge

A library's Cargo.toml floors are a promise to consumers, so in-range updates move only Cargo.lock. Cargo.lock may then need a newer Rust than the MSRV: that's fine, because the MSRV CI job resolves afresh like a consumer on the MSRV (see docs/dependency-updates.md).
dist generates this workflow and its plan job fails if it drifts from what dist would generate. Its actions move when `cargo-dist-version` is bumped and `dist generate` re-run.

The MSRV CI job pins the oldest toolchain we support on purpose; bumping it would stop checking the MSRV at all. Move it by hand together with rust-version in Cargo.toml (see docs/dependency-updates.md).
The SMB benchmark harness is excluded from the workspace because sspi pins digest =0.11.0-rc.5, which conflicts with digest 0.11.2. Independent bumps there can never resolve.
